problems.quote: In an alternate schedule where they work on different days, you calculate the total work done in one full cycle (A's turn + B's turn).
problems.problem: The example given (A works Mon/Wed, B works Tue/Thu) has a 4-day cycle with two turns each, but the method describes a cycle as one turn each.
problems.correction: In an alternate schedule, calculate total work done in one full cycle (the repeating pattern of work days).
problems.verifierReason: Original defines cycle as one turn each; example shows 4-day cycle with two turns each. Correction generalizes correctly.
